_experiment.description: Neuron-level pruning on the reference [196,10,10,10] network. Structured counterpart to the weight-level baseline: removes one hidden neuron per step (row of W[l] + column of W[l+1] + bias b[l][i]) using the same manifold-distance criterion d_W. 15 steps covers 75% of the 20 hidden neurons before catastrophic collapse. Compare sparsification_log.csv (weight) vs neuron_sparsification_log.csv (neuron) on val_acc vs neuron_sparsity axes.
